1→"""
     2→setup_translators_ui.py
     3→
     4→UE5.7 Editor Utility Script for The Translators Card
     5→Run this script in the UE5 Python console to verify setup.
     6→
     7→Usage:
     8→    import setup_translators_ui
     9→    setup_translators_ui.run_setup()
    10→
    11→Or run individual functions:
    12→    setup_translators_ui.check_plugins()
    13→    setup_translators_ui.find_bridge_component()
    14→    setup_translators_ui.create_directories()
    15→"""
    16→
    17→import unreal
    18→from pathlib import Path
    19→
    20→
    21→# === CONFIGURATION ===
    22→BRIDGE_DIR = Path.home() / ".translators"
    23→PROJECT_CONTENT_DIR = "/Game/TranslatorsCard"
    24→
    25→
    26→def log(message: str, level: str = "info"):
    27→    """Log with [TranslatorsSetup] prefix"""
    28→    prefix = "[TranslatorsSetup]"
    29→    if level == "warning":
    30→        unreal.log_warning(f"{prefix} {message}")
    31→    elif level == "error":
    32→        unreal.log_error(f"{prefix} {message}")
    33→    else:
    34→        unreal.log(f"{prefix} {message}")
    35→
    36→
    37→def check_plugins() -> dict:
    38→    """
    39→    Verify required plugins are enabled.
    40→    Returns dict with plugin status.
    41→    """
    42→    log("Checking required plugins...")
    43→
    44→    results = {
    45→        "USDImporter": False,
    46→        "PythonScriptPlugin": True,  # Must be true if this script runs
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    # Check USD Importer
    50→    try:
    51→        # If we can find USD-related classes, the plugin is loaded
    52→        usd_classes = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.list_assets(
    53→            "/Engine/Plugins/USD", recursive=False
    54→        )
    55→        results["USDImporter"] = True
    56→        log("  USD Importer: ENABLED")
    57→    except:
    58→        log("  USD Importer: NOT FOUND - Enable in Edit > Plugins", "warning")
    59→
    60→    log("  Python Script Plugin: ENABLED (you're running this script)")
    61→
    62→    return results
    63→
    64→
    65→def create_directories():
    66→    """
    67→    Create project directories for Translators assets.
    68→    """
    69→    log("Creating asset directories...")
    70→
    71→    directories = [
    72→        f"{PROJECT_CONTENT_DIR}/UI",
    73→        f"{PROJECT_CONTENT_DIR}/Materials",
    74→        f"{PROJECT_CONTENT_DIR}/Fonts",
    75→        f"{PROJECT_CONTENT_DIR}/Audio",
    76→    ]
    77→
    78→    for dir_path in directories:
    79→        if not unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_directory_exist(dir_path):
    80→            unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.make_directory(dir_path)
    81→            log(f"  Created: {dir_path}")
    82→        else:
    83→            log(f"  Exists: {dir_path}")
    84→
    85→    # Also ensure the bridge directory exists on disk
    86→    BRIDGE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    87→    log(f"  Bridge directory: {BRIDGE_DIR}")
    88→
    89→
    90→def find_bridge_component() -> bool:
    91→    """
    92→    Search for BridgeComponent in the current level.
    93→    Returns True if found.
    94→    """
    95→    log("Searching for BridgeComponent...")
    96→
    97→    # Get all actors in level
    98→    actors = unreal.EditorLevelLibrary.get_all_level_actors()
    99→
   100→    for actor in actors:
   101→        # Check if actor has BridgeComponent
   102→        components = actor.get_components_by_class(unreal.ActorComponent)
   103→        for component in components:
   104→            class_name = component.get_class().get_name()
   105→            if "BridgeComponent" in class_name:
   106→                log(f"  FOUND: {actor.get_name()} has BridgeComponent")
   107→                return True
   108→
   109→    log("  NOT FOUND - Add an Actor with BridgeComponent to your level", "warning")
   110→    return False
   111→
   112→
   113→def find_usd_stage_actor() -> bool:
   114→    """
   115→    Search for USD Stage Actor in the current level.
   116→    Returns True if found.
   117→    """
   118→    log("Searching for USD Stage Actor...")
   119→
   120→    actors = unreal.EditorLevelLibrary.get_all_level_actors()
   121→
   122→    for actor in actors:
   123→        class_name = actor.get_class().get_name()
   124→        if "UsdStageActor" in class_name:
   125→            log(f"  FOUND: {actor.get_name()}")
   126→            return True
   127→
   128→    log("  NOT FOUND - Add a USD Stage Actor to your level", "warning")
   129→    return False
   130→
   131→
   132→def print_setup_instructions():
   133→    """
   134→    Print instructions for manual setup steps.
   135→    """
   136→    log("=" * 60)
   137→    log("TRANSLATORS CARD SETUP INSTRUCTIONS")
   138→    log("=" * 60)
   139→
   140→    instructions = """
   141→1. CREATE WIDGET BLUEPRINTS:
   142→   - Right-click in Content Browser > User Interface > Widget Blueprint
   143→   - For each widget, select the C++ parent class:
   144→     * WBP_QuestionDisplay (parent: W_QuestionDisplay)
   145→     * WBP_OptionButton (parent: W_OptionButton)
   146→     * WBP_ProgressIndicator (parent: W_ProgressIndicator)
   147→
   148→2. DESIGN THE WIDGETS:
   149→   WBP_QuestionDisplay needs:
   150→   - TextBlock named "QuestionText"
   151→   - TextBlock named "ProgressText"
   152→   - VerticalBox named "OptionsContainer"
   153→   - Border named "BackgroundBorder" (optional)
   154→
   155→   WBP_OptionButton needs:
   156→   - Button named "OptionButton"
   157→   - TextBlock named "OptionLabel"
   158→   - Border named "ButtonBorder" (optional)
   159→
   160→3. SET UP LEVEL:
   161→   - Add an empty Actor to your level
   162→   - Add BridgeComponent to that Actor
   163→   - Add USD Stage Actor (Place Actors > USD)
   164→   - Point USD Stage to: ~/.translators/cognitive_substrate.usda
   165→
   166→4. SET GAME MODE:
   167→   - World Settings > Game Mode Override > TranslatorsGameMode
   168→   - Or create a Blueprint child of TranslatorsGameMode
   169→
   170→5. TEST:
   171→   - Run: python ~/.claude/bridges/ue5_translators_bridge.py
   172→   - Press Play in Editor
   173→   - Questions should appear when bridge connects
   174→"""
   175→    print(instructions)
   176→    log("Instructions printed above")
   177→
   178→
   179→def create_simple_material():
   180→    """
   181→    Create a simple unlit material for 8-bit aesthetic.
   182→    """
   183→    log("Creating 8-bit material...")
   184→
   185→    material_path = f"{PROJECT_CONTENT_DIR}/Materials/M_8Bit_Base"
   186→
   187→    # Check if already exists
   188→    if unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist(material_path):
   189→        log(f"  Material already exists: {material_path}")
   190→        return
   191→
   192→    # Create material asset
   193→    asset_tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()
   194→
   195→    try:
   196→        factory = unreal.MaterialFactoryNew()
   197→        material = asset_tools.create_asset(
   198→            "M_8Bit_Base",
   199→            f"{PROJECT_CONTENT_DIR}/Materials",
   200→            unreal.Material,
   201→            factory
   202→        )
   203→
   204→        if material:
   205→            # Set to unlit (no lighting calculations)
   206→            material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_UNLIT)
   207→            log(f"  Created: {material_path}")
   208→        else:
   209→            log("  Failed to create material", "warning")
   210→
   211→    except Exception as e:
   212→        log(f"  Error creating material: {e}", "error")
   213→
   214→
   215→def run_setup():
   216→    """
   217→    Run complete setup verification.
   218→    """
   219→    log("=" * 60)
   220→    log("TRANSLATORS CARD SETUP VERIFICATION")
   221→    log("=" * 60)
   222→
   223→    # Check plugins
   224→    plugins = check_plugins()
   225→
   226→    # Create directories
   227→    create_directories()
   228→
   229→    # Find components
   230→    has_bridge = find_bridge_component()
   231→    has_usd = find_usd_stage_actor()
   232→
   233→    # Summary
   234→    log("")
   235→    log("=" * 60)
   236→    log("SETUP SUMMARY")
   237→    log("=" * 60)
   238→
   239→    all_good = True
   240→
   241→    if plugins.get("USDImporter"):
   242→        log("  [OK] USD Importer enabled")
   243→    else:
   244→        log("  [!!] USD Importer - ENABLE in Edit > Plugins", "warning")
   245→        all_good = False
   246→
   247→    if has_bridge:
   248→        log("  [OK] BridgeComponent found in level")
   249→    else:
   250→        log("  [!!] BridgeComponent - ADD to an Actor in level", "warning")
   251→        all_good = False
   252→
   253→    if has_usd:
   254→        log("  [OK] USD Stage Actor found in level")
   255→    else:
   256→        log("  [!!] USD Stage Actor - ADD from Place Actors > USD", "warning")
   257→        all_good = False
   258→
   259→    log("")
   260→    if all_good:
   261→        log("All checks passed! Ready to test.")
   262→        log("Run: python ~/.claude/bridges/ue5_translators_bridge.py")
   263→        log("Then: Press Play in Editor")
   264→    else:
   265→        log("Some items need attention. See warnings above.")
   266→        print_setup_instructions()
   267→
   268→
   269→# Auto-run when imported (optional)
   270→if __name__ == "__main__":
   271→    run_setup()
   272→
